newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: S&P rates Australian Mortgage Sec bond issue.
newsitem.headline: S&P rates Australian Mortgage Sec bond issue.

text.p: Standard & Poor's said it has assigned its AAA rating to a A$485 million tranche 1 mortgage backed securities bonds issued by ARMS II Funds II.
It has also rated the A$15 million tranche 2 bonds under the issue. Australian Mortgage Securities is the fund manager.
BZW Australia Ltd is the lead manager and Deustche Morgan Grenfell Australia Ltd is the lead arranger.
S&P said the ratings reflect the credit quality of the assets of Fund II, the enhancement provided by creditworthy third parties and the maintenance of a minimum level of cash collateral.

It also reflects, for the tranche 1 bonds, the first-loss protection provided by the subordination of the tranche 2 bonds, which represent 3.0 percent of the outstanding bonds issued Fund II, it added.
Tranche 1 will be entitled to receive principal and interest in full prior to tranche 2, which are rated AA minus.

The bonds are pass-through bonds, and principal will be repaid to bond holders monthly as allocated under the transaction documents, while the risk of prepayment is borne by the bondholders, S&P said.
Assets of Fund II consist of a pool of residential property mortgages and other appropriately rated investments.
